# Rotate / Auto-Orient Images

> 🤖 *AI Drafted (Not reviewed)*

Create rotated or EXIF-oriented image derivatives without modifying the originals. Use this as the camera/DSLR watched-folder capture preset for auto-orienting imports and writing JPGs for downstream image editing or OCR workflows.
